thimble.definition:
n. as much as a thimble will hold
n. a small metal cap to protect the finger while sewing; can be used as a small container
thimble.translation:
n. 顶针, 嵌环, 套管
[机] 套管

thimbleberries.translation: n. 糙莓( thimbleberry的名词复数 )

thimbleberry.definition:
n shrubby raspberry of eastern North America having showy rose to purplish flowers and red or orange thimble-shaped fruit
n white-flowered raspberry of western North America and northern Mexico with thimble-shaped orange berries
n raspberry native to eastern North America having black thimble-shaped fruit

thimbled.translation: n. (缝纫机用的)顶针，针箍；【机械工程】套筒，套管

thimbleflower.translation: 针箍花, 麦枯草, 毛地黄, 吉莉草

thimbleful.definition: n as much as a thimble will hold

thimblefuls.translation: n. （酒等的）极少量( thimbleful的名词复数 )

thimblerig.definition: n a swindling sleight-of-hand game; victim guesses which of three things a pellet is under
thimblerig.translation:
n. 藏豆赌博戏
vi. 玩藏豆赌博戏骗钱, 欺骗

thimblerigged.translation: v. 欺骗( thimblerig的过去式和过去分词 )

thimblerigger.definition:
n. One who cheats by thimblerigging, or tricks of
   legerdemain.

thimblerigging.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Thimblerig
thimblerigging.translation: v. 欺骗( thimblerig的现在分词 )

thimbles.definition:
n. as much as a thimble will hold
n. a small metal cap to protect the finger while sewing; can be used as a small container
thimbles.translation: n. （缝纫用的）顶针( thimble的复数形式 ); 针箍; 套筒; 套管

thimbleweed.definition: n a common North American anemone with cylindrical fruit clusters resembling thimbles
thimbleweed.translation: 银莲花属植物, 木本银莲花属

thimerosal.definition: n. a light-colored crystalline powder (trade name Merthiolate) used as a surgical antiseptic
thimerosal.translation:
n. 硫汞撒
[医] 硫汞撒, 乙汞硫代水杨酸钠

thimerosal ointment.translation: [医] 噻汞撒软膏, 汞硫雷软膏

thimerosal(ate).translation: [化] 硫柳汞; 硫柳汞钠

thimet.translation: 三九一一, 甲拌磷(药)
